ml.interpretation: Spectrally unusual vegetation relative to the current sample; no drought, disease or crop-failure diagnosis.

compact_sample_calculations.scope: Reproduction of the workflow on a subset; sample quantiles are not full-scene quantiles.

stage2_methodology.boundary_note: Requested 0-24/25-49/50-74/75-100 classes expressed as continuous intervals; no rounding before classification.
stage2_methodology.calibration: Threshold and supporting coefficients are unvalidated PoC design choices, not fitted weights or disease thresholds.
stage2_methodology.interpretation: Lower NDMI rank drives risk. Lower NDVI/NDRE ranks strengthen supporting evidence, without adding an independent stress term.
stage2_methodology.name: Scene-relative spectral moisture-stress risk, PoC v1
stage2_methodology.percentile_definition: P_X = 100 * (count(X < x) + 0.5 * count(X == x)) / N; ties share midranks
stage2_methodology.reference_population: NDVI-screened, quality-valid vegetation with finite NDVI, NDRE and NDMI

stage2_statistics.reference_population: NDVI-screened, quality-valid vegetation with finite NDVI, NDRE and NDMI
stage2_statistics.statistics_conventions: Population standard deviation; unscaled MAD; linear interpolated quantiles

limitations: Compact calculations reproduce the workflow, not all full-scene statistics. The validated full-scene decision is loaded separately from the committed product contract and evidence package.
Noncontiguous pixel sample. Flat indices identify original pixels; array order is not a spatial map.
Acquisition-time eligibility only; historical publication/processing/operational availability is not established.
Quality-valid sampling excludes masked pixels; sample vegetation coverage is not full-scene coverage.
ML is fitted and scored within the same sample; it is exploratory, not an out-of-sample evaluation.
Exact floating-point results can vary across library versions, BLAS implementations or hardware.
Evidence levels describe available capability, not accuracy, confidence, probability or guarantees; more sources do not automatically improve accuracy.
Analyse agricultural areas using Earth-observation data available for that location; coverage and usable quality differ by place and time.
Decision support only. No autonomous intervention is allowed in this PoC; no decision state establishes a diagnosis.
Experimental spectral anomaly evidence is complementary only; not drought or disease detection, probability, calibrated agronomic prediction or ground truth.
Ground observations are unavailable; no ground measurements have been simulated.
Stage 4 uses only acquisitions at or before the decision cutoff; later observations in the requested season do not select this decision.
This is an acquisition-time-gated retrospective reconstruction, not proof of operational availability in June 2025.
Relative hotspots are not drought prevalence; regional temporal medians do not validate individual hotspots.
Masks, phenology, crop/canopy and soil differences, mixed pixels and residual atmosphere can confound shared spectral proxies.
The short seasonal baseline is not a climatology; neutral or mixed temporal evidence does not exclude local stress.
The 400-1700 nm window does not simulate Satellite 813 response; correlated evidence is not independent ground truth.

sample_provenance.attribution: Planet Labs PBC, CC-BY-4.0; Sentinel-2: Copernicus / ESA via Microsoft Planetary Computer. Reference notebooks: Dr. Vincent Markiet / Space42.
sample_provenance.availability_caution: Acquisition-time eligibility only; historical publication/processing/operational availability is not established.
sample_provenance.exclusions: Official nodata/cloud/cirrus mask failures excluded before sampling. Retain existing Stage 4.6 usable bands, excluding 1350-1450 nm inclusive (20 bands). ML additionally requires screened vegetation with finite nonnegative non-nodata spectra at every retained band.
sample_provenance.scope: Compact calculations reproduce the workflow, not all full-scene statistics. The validated full-scene decision is loaded separately from the committed product contract and evidence package.
sample_provenance.selection: Uniform sampling without replacement from sorted quality-valid flat pixel indices, PCG64(813), then sort selected indices. No risk-class stratification.
sample_provenance.spatial_interpretation: Noncontiguous pixel sample. Flat indices identify original pixels; array order is not a spatial map.
sample_provenance.spectra_units: Physical surface reflectance; unchanged source float32 values, no scaling, smoothing or imputation.
sample_provenance.temporal_rule: All listed source acquisitions of a daily mosaic must be <= decision_as_of; straddling mosaics excluded in full.

scientific_cautions: No drought probability, disease diagnosis, crop-failure prediction or calibrated confidence.
Ground evidence is required before intervention; automation is disabled.
NDMI drives relative screening; NDVI/NDRE are correlated supporting modifiers.
Experimental unsupervised ML does not change Stage 4's decision.

NDMI.method: Theil-Sen median of pairwise slopes over elapsed days

validated_near_tanager_baseline.method: Equal-weight daily vegetation medians; baseline median, unscaled MAD, target-minus-baseline and tie-aware empirical percentile. Excludes target date; no probability.
